thread:
Amira Khan: dropped a compact prereq pill concept for the on-prem wizard  sits above the stepper and shows per-host mini-badges. figma: https://figma.com/file/prereq-pill

Ben Foster: neat. main ask: pill must show count + worst-state badge (red/amber/green) and allow one-line reason tooltip on hover. also a tiny Retry icon button inside the pill so users can re-run lightweight checks without expanding.

Priya Nair: copy variants for the pill label: (A) Readiness pill 1 hosts 1 Healthy (B) Quick readiness 1 hosts 1 1 issue (C) Prereqs snapshot 1 hosts 1 Degraded. i'd test A vs C for clarity.

Lin Gomez: accessibility: pill should be a `button` with `role=status aria-live=polite aria-atomic=true`. provide sr-only text like "Prereqs: 1 failing check, last checked 30s ago". the mini-badges must include textual labels for screen readers (e.g., `span.sr-only: Host A: Degraded`). avoid color-only cues.

Ben Foster: implementation detail: Retry triggers `/api/preflight/quick?hosts=<ids>` which returns cached-tolerant results and updates pill. show an inline spinner and debounce clicks for 10s. if Retry fails, show a compact toast: "Quick check failed  try full diagnostics" with an action to start full collection.

Amira Khan: UX tweak: when multiple hosts, pill shows worst state + a `>` chevron that opens a micro-list flyout (max 5 visible) with per-host badge + 1-line reason. flyout must be keyboard navigable and support Copy diagnostics per host.

Priya Nair: short reason examples for the flyout: "DNS resolve failed", "Egress blocked by firewall", "SSH timed out", "TLS handshake failed" 1 keep under 45 chars.

Lin Gomez: keyboard flows: pill tabbable; Enter opens flyout; arrow keys navigate host rows; Enter on a host opens full host details. Escape closes flyout and restores focus to pill. for dynamic updates, announce: "Prereqs updated: 1 failing check" via aria-live but don't move focus.

ops-bot: heads-up  accessibility review scheduled 2026-05-04 14:00 UTC. please attach aria snippet in the PR.

Amira Khan: thanks all 1 i'll add the three copy variants into the figma + include a compact aria snippet per Lin. aiming to ship this micro-pattern next sprint. :rocket:
